personalities.name: Anxious
personalities.description: The mount emits the startled emote when being dismounted, player is idle, near a crowd or loud event. If the mount is near other mounts or the player walks away, the sweat drop emote is emitted.

personalities.name: Affectionate
personalities.description: The mount emits the sad emote when the player walks away from them. When the player is idle, or the mount is fed, the nuzzle emote is emitted. If mounted or near other mounts, the heart effect appears.

personalities.name: Clingy
personalities.description: It emits the nuzzle emote when mounted, and the sad emote when dismounted or when the player walks away from it. Mount emits nuzzle emote when near other mounts. When the mount is near a crowd or a loud event, they follow the player more closely.

personalities.name: Curious
personalities.description: The mount emits the question mark emote if a Clue is nearby, when player is idle, mounted, near other mounts or crowd and when hearing a loud event.

personalities.name: Energetic
personalities.description: When the player is idle, 8 point star effect is emitted. When mounted, rays effect or excited emote is emitted. Being fed results in sparkles effect being emitted. If the player walks away, then the mount follows them quickly. Dismounted results in blep emote being emitted.

personalities.name: Grumpy
personalities.description: Mounts always emit both hoof stomp and angry puff emotes in quick succession just after being equipped. The mount emits the angry puff emote when being mounted, and the hoof stomp emote when being dismounted. When the mount is groomed, player is idle, near a crowd or loud event, the angry puff emote is emitted.

personalities.name: Lazy
personalities.description: Usually emits the tired emote when being groomed or if the player is idle. Mounts frequently tends to lie down. When the player walks away, mounts slowly follow them.

personalities.name: Playful
personalities.description: Tends to walk around in circles a lot, and rarely lies down. Approaches other equipped mounts & the player with a tail wag emote. When mounted and dismounted, the blep emote is emitted. When the player walks away, mounts follow playfully.

mutations.name: Chimera Mane
mutations.description: Makes the mane to be pattern colored.

mutations.name: Chimera Tail
mutations.description: Makes the tail to be pattern colored.

mutations.name: Harlequin Mane
mutations.description: Makes the mane to be paint colored.

mutations.name: Harlequin Tail
mutations.description: Makes the tail to be paint colored.

mutations.name: Alien
mutations.description: Coat top, coat bottom, hair, sock and pattern are darkened and retextured with black branching tendrils and glowing spots. The species' eyes glow white and a pattern colored whispy halo swirls around the species' neck.

mutations.name: Arcane
mutations.description: Covers your horse in mystical arcane sigils.

mutations.name: Arisen
mutations.description: Coat Top and Coat Bottom are re-textured with a blue tinted crystal-like pattern, Hair and Hoof becomes transparent, Sock and Keratin becomes glowing. Certain colors can overpower the blue texture. The mount's eyes also glow white and a pattern-colored halo sits around the neck.

mutations.name: Artisan
mutations.description: Covers your horse in a bright artisan design.

mutations.name: Crystallized
mutations.description: Entire species is retextured with a Cyan crystal texture. Certain colors can overpower the cyan.

mutations.name: Dilute
mutations.description: Transforms all colors to a much whiter version, giving your horse a pastel appearance.

mutations.name: Festive Eye
mutations.description: The species' eyes shift between glowing green and red.

mutations.name: Flowering Sakura
mutations.description: Coat Bottom, Hair, and Sock are retextured with sakura petals. The species' eyes glow white and Sock colored petals fall from their legs.

mutations.name: Frost
mutations.description: Recolors the species' base colors to an icy blue with a white snowflake pattern. Certain colors can overpower the blue. A snowflake halo swirls around the species' neck, and the eyes glow light blue.

mutations.name: Geode
mutations.description: Transforms your horse into a geode with crystal regions!

mutations.name: Ghost
mutations.description: Makes the species' base features see-through.

mutations.name: Ghoul
mutations.description: Makes the species' secondary features (Hair, Paint, Pattern, Keratin colored regions) see-through.

mutations.name: Gilded
mutations.description: Adds a gold foil texture overriding the colors of the hoof, keratin, paint, nose, and sock. The color region influences the mutation color.

mutations.name: Glow
mutations.description: A single part of the horse will glow with a magical aura!(Can only apply to Hoof, Hair, Paint, Keratin, Pattern, Sock, or Eyes regions)

mutations.name: Haunting
mutations.description: All regions except Pattern and Paint become see-through, the eyes are solid black, and mini white spheres circle the mount's head.

mutations.name: Jester
mutations.description: Adds a Checkered Texture overriding the colors of the socks, mane and pattern, alongside black diamond leg particles.

mutations.name: Lacebound
mutations.description: Causes your horse to appear adorned in gothic lace. (Applies to Coat Top, Coat Bottom and Sock. The legs have heart particles.)

mutations.name: North Star
mutations.description: Encases your horse in stars.

mutations.name: Porcelain
mutations.description: Hoof, Paint, Pattern, and Keratin are retextured with porcelain pattern. The species' eyes glow dark blue along with glowing Sock.

mutations.name: Reptile
mutations.description: Adds a scale pattern texture overiding the colors of the socks, mane, and pattern.

mutations.name: Rose Infection
mutations.description: Infects your horse with a rose-like texture and glowing eyes. (Applies to Paint, Pattern, Keratin, and Eyes)

mutations.name: Tie Dye
mutations.description: Adds a Tie Dye texture overriding the colors of the hair, hoof, sock, coat top and coat bottom. The color region influences the mutation color.

mutations.name: Trophy
mutations.description: Entire species apart from eyes is retextured with a smooth, metallic material. Color is dictated by the tier of the trophy mutation.

mutations.name: X Ray
mutations.description: Makes every feature see-through and the skeleton becomes visible.

mutations.name: Solar
mutations.description: Entire species is re-painted in red and yellows hues with a bright flare texture and a magical solar neck ring.

mutations.name: Lunar
mutations.description: Entire species is re-painted in blue hues with a sparkling moon texture and a magical lunar neck ring.

mutations.name: Heavenly
mutations.description: Species' coat becomes a pure white with glowing parts, a neck halo, and black glow eyes.

mutations.name: Void
mutations.description: Species' coat becomes a pure black with glowing parts, a neck halo, and white glow eyes.

mutations.name: Astral
mutations.description: Species' coat becomes textured with a star pattern, along with purple glowing parts.
